_comment: Cross-class combo states (Boss 2026-11-25, design/gdd/class-skills.md 3.8). A class skill SETS states on enemies/allies; another skill PAYS OFF a state the target (or the cast) carries. Rules: logic/class_skills/combos.gd (pure). Display: client/combo_ui.gd reads states{} and skills{}. duration = seconds. sunder is the existing effects.json status (DEF -40%), applied with this duration; stagger also counts a stun/shock/sleep, airborne a launched fighter, hasted the haste status. Every other state is a plain marker in Fighter.combo_states (no stat change by itself), so it also lands on bosses. Payoff fields: needs = state ids; match all (default) or any; scope target = checked per enemy hit, cast = checked once when the skill fires. The other numbers are the payoff's effect (read by logic/class_skills/combos.gd). PLACEHOLDERS until the Boss plays (docs/po_defaults.md 2026-11-25).
_mark_bonus: Any hit (basic attack or skill, any class) on a marked enemy deals x(1 + mark_bonus).

pilot._hold_max: Seconds a pilot may hold a ready skill while an ally's cast is about to set a state it pays off (Starfall waits for Hook Sweep).
